services.desc: you’ve been thinking about experiencing the wild beauty of the Florida Everglades, now is the perfect time to do it. From December through April, the Everglades enters its dry season, a period that offers the most ideal conditions for an unforgettable airboat adventure. Here’s why the current season offers the ultimate Everglades airboat tour experience: During the dry season, the Everglades enjoys mild temperatures, low humidity, and clear blue skies. Unlike the rainy summer months, you won’t have to worry about pop-up storms or steamy heat. At Airboat in Everglades, we’re proud to offer tours that showcase the unique beauty of this incredible environment while educating visitors about its ecological significance and the thrilling history of airboats. Let’s dive into why the Everglades is so important, the origins of the airboat, and what you can expect during your unforgettable adventure with us.
